description: Two Q15 signed 16-bit multiplies. Lane k operands are a[16k+:16] and b[16k+:16]; value=clamp_s16((a_k*b_k + 2^14) >>> 15) using a floor shift. aux[1:0]=lanes clamped. fault=any clamp, which covers (-32768)*(-32768).
hardware_advantage: Fixed-point mix/gain stage: two Q15 multiplies with rounding and saturation per beat, no software multiply-high routine.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
